about.heading: Engineering With Purpose
about.bio:
I'm a pre-final year Mechanical Engineering student at Delhi Technological University, with hands-on internship experience at Engineers India Limited (EIL) and DRDO-SSPL.

My work spans plant design and piping layouts in AutoCAD, pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II, and research into cryogenic refrigeration systems for precision defence electronics. I'm passionate about simulation-driven engineering — from FEA topology optimization to CFD aerodynamic analysis and detailed CAD modelling.

Recognized as a Dell Aspire Scholar (2023) and NCC Independence Day Cadet who represented Delhi at Red Fort, I bring technical depth, curiosity, and a drive to build things that work in the real world.

projects.title: Topology Optimization of Bike Suspension Arm
projects.desc: Structural FEA and topology optimization to reduce mass while maintaining structural integrity.
projects.work: Performed structural FEA and topology optimization on a bike suspension arm. Evaluated Von Mises stress distributions, deformation maps, and stiffness-to-weight improvements after iterative redesign cycles.
projects.result: 18–30% weight reduction achieved while maintaining required structural strength.

projects.title: Aerodynamic Analysis of Rear Car Spoiler
projects.desc: CFD simulation using k-ε / k-ω SST models to study drag and downforce effects on a rear spoiler.
projects.work: Conducted full CFD simulation: geometry setup, mesh generation, solver configuration with k-ε and k-ω SST turbulence models, post-processing of pressure and velocity contours.
projects.result: 10–25% increase in downforce  ·  5–12% drag reduction via geometry optimization.

projects.title: Differential Gear Assembly
projects.desc: Full 3D modelling of a bevel-gear differential assembly with all sub-components and detailed drawings.

projects.title: Planetary Gear System
projects.desc: Parametric CAD model of a planetary gear set — sun gear, planet gears, ring gear and carrier assembly.
